Vanessa —

I ran Solstice’s VAT number through VIES and the number they provided (GB987654321) came back valid. Link to the VIES response attached in the thread links. That means for UK->UK B2B after Brexit we still apply reverse-charge on the invoice when the buyer is VAT-registered and the seller is outside the buyer’s VAT accounting scope. For our records: we should include Redwood’s VAT number (GB123456789) and a line on the invoice stating ‘Reverse charge — VAT accounted for by the customer (Art. 196)’ and set VAT amount = 0.

Marissa — please generate a new invoice PDF with the wording above and include PO 68321 if confirmed. Also flag this for finance to code as reverse-charge so collections knows how to match.

Rishi
